structure.note: Class A shares are non-voting except in limited circumstances; Class B shares carry one vote each. After the September 2025 resolution of the Murdoch Family Trust litigation, the trust's Class A shares and most of its Class B shares went to LGC Holdco, LLC, owned equally by trusts associated with Lachlan, Grace and Chloe Murdoch; it holds 62,584,577 Class B shares (34.8% of the class at August 28, 2026; the FY2026 10-K says approximately 34.52% at June 30, 2026). Its votes are decided by a managing director whom Lachlan Murdoch appoints, so Lachlan may be deemed the beneficial owner (he disclaims it). The 10-K says the parties agreed not to let LGC Holdco, the LGC Family Trusts and the 'Murdoch Individuals' (K. Rupert, Lachlan, Grace and Chloe Murdoch) together exceed 44% of Class B voting power. No one holds a majority of votes.

Sources: FY2026 Form 10-K (accession 0001564708-26-000175, filed August 7, 2026) and the proxy published after it, the 2026 DEF 14A (accession 0001104659-26-109969, filed September 23, 2026, ownership as of August 28, 2026). LEADER: Rupert Murdoch has been Chairman Emeritus, not a director, since November 15, 2023; he is not a named executive officer and does not appear in the 2026 proxy's ownership table. The Murdoch Family Trust, through which the FY2025 10-K attributed about 41.2% of Class B to him, no longer holds the shares: the FY2026 10-K says its Class A shares and most of its Class B shares were transferred to LGC Holdco in September 2025. Neither filing reports any holding for him, so status is no-reported-stake (it was 'holds' with 41.2% of Class B votes in the FY2025 edition). The only current mention of him in the ownership context is the 10-K's 44% voting cap covering the 'Murdoch Individuals'. LARGEST HOLDERS are listed on a class basis (the proxy gives only % of Class A or of Class B, not of all shares): LGC Holdco 34.8% of Class B; Independent Franchise Partners 8.9% of Class A (it also holds 9,423,928 Class B shares, 5.2% of Class B, as of June 30, 2025); SOF Ltd 5.4% of Class B (as of December 31, 2022, so stale). Lachlan Murdoch's 62,586,041 Class B shares include LGC Holdco's, so he is not listed separately. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' ($204m) includes dividends to REA Group minority holders; the MD&A splits it into $112m to News Corporation stockholders and $92m to REA Group minority stockholders, so $112m is recorded. BUYBACKS: $641m of News Corp Class A and Class B shares; REA Group's own buyback ($141m) is excluded. GEOGRAPHY: the 10-K footnotes give the U.S. alone at about $4.2bn; Australasia comprises Australia, Asia, Papua New Guinea and New Zealand. No broad employee stock purchase plan was identified, so plan is null.
